description: This file contains shared utility functions and constants for benchmarking scaled matrix multiplication operations in PyTorch, including shape definitions, module import helpers, dtype normalization, and platform capability checks.

methods.name: get_test_scaled_matmul_cuda
methods.description: Loads and caches the test_scaled_matmul_cuda.py module for reuse in benchmarks.

methods.name: get_float8_dtype
methods.description: Normalizes FP8 dtype input to internal torch types, handling various aliases.

methods.name: build_equal_k_group_offs
methods.description: Creates a tensor of group end offsets for partitioning the K dimension into equal parts.

methods.name: supports_fp8_deepseek_blockwise_scaling
methods.description: Checks if the current platform supports DeepSeek-style FP8 blockwise scaling based on CUDA and device properties.
